attack_techniques: Modify Cloud Compute Infrastructure: Delete Cloud Instance (T1578.003)
attackers_goals: Evade defensive measures by deleting a possibly malicious service principal.
description: A service principal was removed from Azure. This indicates a change in access permissions and may indicate malicious activity.
investigative_actions: Check the Azure Active Directory audit logs for the details of the removed service principal.* Check the Azure role assignments to identify which resources were impacted by the removal of the service principal.
name: A Service Principal was removed from Azure
